campaign.title: Protocol 8:15 · 3. Who Said “Keep Quiet”?
campaign.finale: Case solved! Ms Diop took Karina to safety. Mr El Idrissi delayed the repair and told Ms Diop to keep quiet. You shared your pictures and found the truth. Talk about it: was Ms Diop right to lie?

roles.name: Message checker
roles.card: You check messages. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it says.
roles.clue: Your picture: two school messages at 8:15. One says “Stay in classrooms.” One says “Go to the sports hall.”

card.ca: Comproves missatges. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què diu.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: dos missatges de l’institut a les 8:15. Un diu «Quedeu-vos a les aules». L’altre diu «Aneu al pavelló».

roles.name: People checker
roles.card: You listen to people. Look at your picture. Tell your team who said what.
roles.clue: Your picture: Youssef says, “Karina went to take a photo of the broken roof.”

card.ca: Escoltes la gent. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip qui va dir què.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: en Youssef diu: «La Karina va anar a fer una foto del sostre trencat».

roles.name: Document checker
roles.card: You read papers. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it says.
roles.clue: Your picture: the school storm plan. In a storm: stay in your classroom.

card.ca: Llegeixes documents. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què diu.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: el pla de tempesta de l’institut. Si hi ha tempesta: queda’t a l’aula.

roles.name: Place checker
roles.card: You look at places. Look at your picture. Tell your team what you see.
roles.clue: Your picture: a photo of the broken roof. It is over the covered passage, next to the sports hall.

card.ca: Mires llocs. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què hi veus.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: una foto del sostre trencat. És sobre el passadís cobert, al costat del pavelló.

chapters.title: 3. Who Said “Keep Quiet”?
chapters.intro: Karina is safe. But someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet. Who? You have a new picture. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it shows. Answer together.
chapters.recap: Karina is safe in the first-aid room. Someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet.
chapters.ending: You solved it! Karina is safe. Ms Diop helped her. Mr El Idrissi delayed the repair and told Ms Diop to keep quiet. Now the passage is closed.

objectives.text: Who told Ms Diop to keep quiet? Write the name. Ask the People checker and the Document checker.

help.ca: Qui va dir a la senyora Diop que callés? Escriu el nom. Pregunta al People checker i al Document checker.

objectives.text: When did the school first know about the broken roof? Ask the Message checker and the Place checker.

help.ca: Quan va saber l’institut, per primer cop, que el sostre estava trencat? Pregunta al Message checker i al Place checker.

objectives.text: Write a note to the head teacher: “The roof was dangerous since… Ms Diop… Mr El Idrissi…”

help.ca: Escriviu una nota a la directora: «El sostre era perillós des de… La senyora Diop… El senyor El Idrissi…»

objectives.successCriteria: A short note saying the roof was dangerous since Friday, that Ms Diop warned the school and helped Karina, and that Mr El Idrissi delayed the repair and told her to keep quiet. Simple A2 sentences are fine.

discoveries.text: Karina: “I am OK. Ms Diop brought me here at 8:12.”

help.ca: La Karina: «Estic bé. La senyora Diop em va portar aquí a les 8:12».

discoveries.text: A note on the office door: “Passage closed. Repair it now.”

help.ca: Una nota a la porta de secretaria: «Passadís tancat. Repareu-lo ara».

reveals.text: Tip: People checker and Document checker, compare your pictures. What is the deputy head’s name?

help.ca: Pista: People checker i Document checker, compareu les vostres imatges. Com es diu el cap d’estudis?

reveals.text: Tip: Message checker and Place checker, compare your pictures. Which day was the warning?

help.ca: Pista: Message checker i Place checker, compareu les vostres imatges. Quin dia va ser l’avís?

roleClues.witness-interviewer: Your picture: Ms Diop says, “The deputy head told me to keep quiet. I was scared.”
roleClues.records-researcher: Your picture: the school staff list. The deputy head is Mr El Idrissi.
roleClues.media-analyst: Your picture: an email from Mr El Idrissi: “Do not mention Friday’s warning. Say it is new storm damage.”
roleClues.site-observer: Your picture: what happened, in order. First, on Friday: a warning about the roof. Then, on Monday: the storm.

introImage.alt: A message from Karina’s account at 8:28: “I’m safe. Someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet.”

intro.ca: La Karina està bé. Però algú va dir a la senyora Diop que callés. Qui? Tens una imatge nova. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què mostra. Responeu junts.

recap.ca: La Karina està bé a la infermeria. Algú va dir a la senyora Diop que callés.

ending.ca: Ho heu resolt! La Karina està bé. La senyora Diop la va ajudar. El senyor El Idrissi va ajornar la reparació i va dir a la senyora Diop que callés. Ara el passadís està tancat.

witness-interviewer.ca: La teva imatge: la senyora Diop diu: «El cap d’estudis em va dir que callés. Tenia por».

records-researcher.ca: La teva imatge: la llista del personal. El cap d’estudis és el senyor El Idrissi.

media-analyst.ca: La teva imatge: un correu del senyor El Idrissi: «No esmenteu l’avís de divendres. Digueu que són danys nous de la tempesta».

site-observer.ca: La teva imatge: què va passar, en ordre. Primer, divendres: un avís sobre el sostre. Després, dilluns: la tempesta.

witness-interviewer.alt: Ms Diop, the PE teacher, says: “The deputy head told me to keep quiet. I was scared.”

records-researcher.alt: School staff: Deputy head, Mr El Idrissi. PE teacher, Ms Diop. Maths teacher, Ms Sokolova. Teacher, Ms Ionescu.

media-analyst.alt: An email from Mr El Idrissi, deputy head: “Delay the repair.” Monday 8:14: “Do not mention Friday’s warning. Say it is new storm damage.”

site-observer.alt: A timeline: Friday 9:20 warning, 9:45 receipt. Monday: 8:07 Ms Diop and Karina enter the hall, 8:12 first aid, 8:14 hide the warning, 8:15 two messages, 8:16 Karina not in class, 8:28 “I’m safe”.

finale.ca: Cas resolt! La senyora Diop va portar la Karina a un lloc segur. El senyor El Idrissi va ajornar la reparació i va dir a la senyora Diop que callés. Heu compartit les vostres imatges i heu descobert la veritat. Parleu-ne: va fer bé de mentir, la senyora Diop?

cast.about: A student. She is missing after the storm.
